content.english: I shall sing to the One awesome in praises,

content.hebrew: אֵל חַי : אֵל חַי וְהַקַּיָּם : עוֹשֶֹה גְדוֹלוֹת:
content.transliteration: El ḥai, el ḥai vehaḳḳayyam :‘osé ḡedolot.
content.english: The Living God / the Living and Abiding God who performs great deeds!

content.hebrew: אֵל חַי : אֵל חַי וְהַקַּיָּם : עוֹשֶֹה גְדוֹלוֹת:
content.transliteration: El ḥai, el ḥai vehaḳḳayyam :‘osé ḡedolot.
content.english: The Living God / the Living and Abiding God who performs great deeds!
The one who created varied forms in His universe
Chose Israel among all the others.
Therefore, we shall sing joyous songs
For Him; we shall awaken with our praise.

content.hebrew: אֵל חַי : אֵל חַי וְהַקַּיָּם : עוֹשֶֹה גְדוֹלוֹת:
content.transliteration: El ḥai, el ḥai vehaḳḳayyam :‘osé ḡedolot.
content.english: The Living God / the Living and Abiding God who performs great deeds!
He desired and sanctified the seventh day for Himself.
He called it “the Sabbath,” my King and my Shepherd.

content.hebrew: בּוֹ יוֹם אֲנִי אֶשְׁכַּח : נוֹדִי וְנוֹעִי
content.transliteration: Bo yom ani eshkaḥ : nodi veno‘i
content.english: On that day, I shall forget all my wanderings

content.hebrew: אַקְדִּישׁ בְּשִֹמְחָה רַב : תּוֹךְ כָּל קְהִלּוֹת:
content.transliteration: Aḳdish besimḥa rav : toch kol ḳehillot.
content.english: And joyously hallow the One great among all congregations.

content.hebrew: אֵל חַי : אֵל חַי וְהַקַּיָּם : עוֹשֶֹה גְדוֹלוֹת:
content.transliteration: El ḥai, el ḥai vehaḳḳayyam :‘osé ḡedolot.
content.english: The Living God / the Living and Abiding God who performs great deeds!
Sanctify yourselves today, O descendants of the righteous!
Small and great alike, children and parents!
All your sorrows and confusions, O pure and untainted ones—

content.hebrew: עִזְבוּ וְשַׁבְּחוּ צוּר : עִם קוֹל הֲמוּלּוֹת:
content.english: Leave them behind and praise the Rock with festive sound!

content.hebrew: אֵל חַי : אֵל חַי וְהַקַּיָּם : עוֹשֶֹה גְדוֹלוֹת:
content.transliteration: El ḥai, el ḥai vehaḳḳayyam :‘osé ḡedolot.
content.english: The Living God / the Living and Abiding God who performs great deeds!
Turn away and flee from the delights of the body,
Instead, go and chase after intellectual delights!

content.hebrew: הַיּוֹם בְּנֵי אֵל חַי : חוּשׁוּ וְהִלְכוּ
content.transliteration: Hayyom bené el ḥai : ḥushu vehilchu
content.english: Today, O children of the living God, go in haste

content.hebrew: בֵּית אֵל לְהִתְפַּלֵּל : עִם רוֹב תְּפִלּוֹת:
content.english: To God’s house and pray a host of prayers.

content.hebrew: אֵל חַי : אֵל חַי וְהַקַּיָּם : עוֹשֶֹה גְדוֹלוֹת:
content.transliteration: El ḥai, el ḥai vehaḳḳayyam :‘osé ḡedolot.
content.english: The Living God / the Living and Abiding God who performs great deeds!
He will soon destroy the plunderers and thugs,
The Rock will bring upon them indignation and wrath.
If you observe the Sabbath without transgression,
You will soon be released from darkness.

content.hebrew: אֵל חַי : אֵל חַי וְהַקַּיָּם : עוֹשֶֹה גְדוֹלוֹת:
content.transliteration: El ḥai, el ḥai vehaḳḳayyam :‘osé ḡedolot.
content.english: The Living God / the Living and Abiding God who performs great deeds!
The one who remembers and redeems will remember His covenant
And restore the people of His inheritance upon their mound.
The Rock will truly fulfill His word:
I shall return, and the House of Habitation will be rebuilt!

content.hebrew: אֵל חַי : אֵל חַי וְהַקַּיָּם : עוֹשֶֹה גְדוֹלוֹת:
content.transliteration: El ḥai, el ḥai vehaḳḳayyam :‘osé ḡedolot.
content.english: The Living God / the Living and Abiding God who performs great deeds!
